title: From Risk Scoring to Risk Allocation: A Density-Driven Framework for Diverse Monitoring in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.26146v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Risk monitoring in multi-agent systems is commonly built on a per-state primitive that scores each state independently and selects the top K. Under crowding, where many agents share the same fragility, this approach picks redundant alerts whose risks are jointly correlated, a pattern we describe as ``herding in monitoring.'' We propose a paradigm shift from risk scoring to risk allocation, supported by two contributions. First, we identify the Crowding Paradox, namely that P(risk | x) $\propto$ p(x) rather than 1/p(x), so density rather than anomaly score is the operative risk signal; on financial data, density-based scoring reaches AUROC $\geq$ 0.94 at 5d/10d/20d crash horizons, while five anomaly baselines all fall below 0.80. Second, given a density-derived fragility score, we recast monitoring as combinatorial subset selection over interdependent states and map it to a QUBO objective with a $\lambda$-controlled risk--diversity tradeo

translated_title: 从风险评分到风险分配：多智能体系统中多样化监控的密度驱动框架
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统中的风险监控通常建立在逐状态的基元之上，即独立地对每个状态评分并选出前K个。在拥挤情形下——即许多智能体共享相同的脆弱性——这种方法会选出风险相互关联的冗余警报，我们将这种模式描述为“监控中的羊群效应”。我们提出从风险评分到风险分配的范式转变，并由两项贡献支撑。第一，我们识别出“拥挤悖论”，即 P(risk | x) ∝ p(x) 而非 1/p(x)，因此密度而非异常分数才是真正起作用的风险信号；在金融数据上，基于密度的评分在5天/10天/20天崩盘预测期上达到 AUROC ≥ 0.94，而五个异常检测基线均低于 0.80。第二，在给定由密度导出的脆弱性分数后，我们将监控重新表述为在相互依赖的状态上的组合子集选择问题，并将其映射为带 λ 控制的风险-多样性权衡的 QUBO 目标（摘要至此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文揭示“拥挤悖论”——密度而非异常分数才是有效的风险信号，并提出从风险评分到风险分配的范式转变，将多智能体监控建模为带λ参数的QUBO组合优化问题，以在风险与多样性之间取得平衡，避免冗余的“羊群式”警报。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the Crowding Paradox—density, not anomaly score, is the operative risk signal—and proposes a paradigm shift from risk scoring to risk allocation by recasting multi-agent monitoring as a QUBO-based combinatorial subset selection with a λ-controlled risk–diversity tradeoff to avoid redundant herding alerts.
